Assembly by-elections announced in four Indian states

The Election Commission of India has announced by-elections for three assembly seats in three states and one Lok Sabha seat in West Bengal. Voting will take place on October 6, with results to be declared on October 9. The seats include two in West Bengal and one each in Assam and Tripura. The announcement comes amid speculation about potential shifts in election schedules due to census date changes.
